title: Publish SpecSync 5.1.1 in the CorvidLabs Homebrew tap using the verified GitHub Release artifact checksums and validate the formula
description: Publish SpecSync 5.1.1 in the CorvidLabs Homebrew tap using the verified GitHub Release artifact checksums and validate the formula
no_spec_change_rationale: This tap has no canonical module specs; the change updates release-only Homebrew distribution metadata and does not alter SpecSync source behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Formula/spec-sync.rb declares version 5.1.1; all four macOS/Linux URLs resolve to the v5.1.1 GitHub Release; every SHA-256 matches its uploaded archive; formula syntax and Homebrew style pass; and an installed formula binary reports specsync 5.1.1.
